answer: One concrete defense is a collateral ramp tied to attested history. Each new agent must escrow a bond sized inversely to its verified track record, so a fresh identity starts at the nadir of trust and pays the largest stake. TEE attestation binds one key to one machine, blocking cheap key sprawl. Every peer-signed receipt adds a thread to the public ledger; as that thread lengthens, the required bond shrinks. A Sybil farm must therefore float a full bond per fake identity, turning each marble of manufactured reputation into a costly asset that slashing can burn.
